ITEM 1 | Sliced orange carrot pieces, bright orange with slightly darker edges, smooth glossy-looking surface, firm rounded oval slices about 3-4 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, cooked to tender but holding shape, clustered in upper-left of plate covering roughly 12% of plate area | 75
ITEM 2 | Cauliflower florets, pale ivory to creamy yellow, matte with slightly glossy patches, firm but tender, bite-sized clusters about 2-3 cm across with a few small stems, scattered across center of plate covering roughly 25% of plate area, some appear steamed or boiled | 160
ITEM 3 | Small cluster of cooked meat-like pieces, tan to light brown with lighter interior, fibrous crumbly texture, two or three slices about 1 cm thick and 4-5 cm long, slightly browned edges, dry-looking surface, sitting at upper-right edge of plate covering roughly 6% of plate area | 60
ITEM 4 | Green leafy garnish, dark green, flat and slightly wilted, single leaf about 3 cm across tucked beside the meat-like pieces at upper-right | 4
